_comment: Signal-name vocabulary: which words in the part after the colon of a Gen5 Signal Name mean OVER-CURRENT ('oc') or a VBUS / port POWER ENABLE ('vbus'). Regular expressions, matched case-insensitively against the upper-cased signal tail. Edit this file to teach the tool a project's naming - no code change. A signal that matches neither stays an 'other GPIO' (and, in Hybrid mode, the AI is asked about it). --role SIGNAL=oc|vbus overrides a single run. Whatever matches here is still checked against the workbook's own direction (over-current = input, VBUS enable = output).
